issues.display_title: Issue #4059: Add Shareable Google Link as Photographer Portfolio
issues.main_description_html:
Brainstorming File:
2026-06-02-pano-info-photographer-portfolio-buttons-design.md

Acceptance Criteria

AC-1: Add as Portfolio button visibility — photographer user

  • Given the user has applied to or been approved for the photographer directory (state.profile.photographer !== null)
  • And the Google Info card has a share_link value
  • And the tour is not archived
  • Then an "Add as Portfolio" button (blue/primary) appears in the footer after "Copy Share Link"]

AC-2: Add as Portfolio button hidden — non-photographer user

  • Given the user has NOT applied to the photographer directory (state.profile.photographer === null)
  • Then the "Add as Portfolio" button is not rendered, even if a share link exists

AC-3: Add as Portfolio button hidden when no share link

  • Given the user is a photographer
  • And the pano has no share_link
  • Then the "Add as Portfolio" button is not rendered

AC-4: Add as Portfolio action — success

  • Given the "Add as Portfolio" button is visible
  • When the user clicks it
  • Then POST /photographers/portfolio/save is called with { title: <panorama_name>, value: <share_link>, type: 'google' }
  • And the button shows a loading spinner while the request is in flight
  • And on success a toast confirms the save
  • And the entry appears in the Google Street View section of /photographer/portfolio

AC-5: Add as Portfolio action — error

  • When the API call fails
  • Then a toast error message is shown
  • And the button returns to its default state (no spinner)

Demo from Developer

3 Archived tour should hide Add as Portfolio Inspect Google Info card source Button is not rendered when tour.archived is true Button is rendered inside share link row before the !tour?.archived footer guard, so archived tours can still show it Failed
4 UI placement/style acceptance Inspect Google Info card source Blue/primary "Add as Portfolio" button appears in footer after Copy Share Link Current implementation is an icon-only plus button in the share link table row, not the footer after Copy Share Link Failed
5 Test automation Run Playwright source spec Spec should pass if all acceptance criteria are met Spec failed on archived-tour visibility guard Failed

Response Details

1. API Wiring Found

src/pages/Tour/Detail/Edit/hooks/usePanoramaActions.jsx
- url: /photographers/portfolio/save
- title: panoramaInfo?.panorama_name
- value: panoramaInfoGoogle?.share_link
- loading state resets on success/error

2. Failing Acceptance

src/pages/Tour/Detail/Edit/Components/PanoramaDetailGoogle.jsx
- Add as Portfolio button is inside the share_link row.
- Archived guard only wraps CardFooter update actions.
- Therefore the Add as Portfolio button is not protected by !tour?.archived.

3. Test Command

node qa_testing\node_modules\@playwright\test\cli.js test --config=qa_testing\playwright.config.js --project=user --grep "#4059" --no-deps --reporter=list

Result: 1 failed
Failure: Add as Portfolio button should be inside the !tour?.archived guarded action area.

Conclusion

The API hook is present, but issue #4059 cannot be marked as passed because the UI does not satisfy the acceptance criteria. The Add as Portfolio action is not hidden for archived tours and is currently implemented as an icon-only table-row action instead of a blue/primary footer button after Copy Share Link.

issues.display_title: Issue #4060: Implement Virtual Tour Manager Menu on Virtual Tour Dropdown at My Tour
issues.main_description_html:
Brainstorming File:
2026-06-02-virtual-tour-manager-dropdown-item-design.md

Acceptance Criteria

AC-1: Menu item is present

  • Given a tour card with an active virtual tour (dropdown is visible)
  • When the user opens the Virtual Tour dropdown
  • Then "Virtual Tour Manager" appears as the last item in the menu

AC-2: Menu item order

  • Then the order is: View Virtual Tour -> View Google Virtual Tour -> Edit Virtual Tour -> Virtual Tour Manager

AC-3: Shown only if the tour has a main overlay.json file

  • Given a tour where overlay_active is false AND goverlay_active is false
  • When the dropdown is opened (if it is shown by its parent logic)
  • Then "Virtual Tour Manager" still appears - it has no conditional guard

AC-4: Navigation on click

  • When the user clicks "Virtual Tour Manager"
  • Then the app navigates to /my-tours/:mid/hosted using internal SPA routing (no full page reload)
  • And the Virtual Tour Manager page loads for the correct tour

AC-5: Correct tour context

  • Given two different tour cards, each with their own mid
  • When the user clicks "Virtual Tour Manager" on either card
  • Then each navigates to its own /my-tours//hosted - not a shared or hardcoded ID

AC-6: Existing items unaffected

  • Then "View Virtual Tour", "View Google Virtual Tour", and "Edit Virtual Tour" behave exactly as before
  • And their visibility conditions (overlay_active, goverlay_active) are unchanged

AC-7: Localization key present

  • Given the app is running in any supported locale
  • Then the "Virtual Tour Manager" label renders correctly (not as a raw key string)
